title: Pilobol.us P3-08: production CMS app off Papyrus main to repo + packages, deploy Phase 2 schema to the empty production backend
description:
## Goal
Move the production CMS app d11eu9hbs2mipk (newsroom.pilobol.us) off Papyrus main onto the Pilobol.us repo + published packages, and deploy the Phase 2 schema to its existing production backend. Done while the backend is still EMPTY, so no data can be lost.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06, read-only AWS)
- Backend (AppSync daczqhhg25b2nfgrzpyc4vd7eq): every one of the 39 DynamoDB tables has 0 rows (scan COUNT), the media bucket has 0 objects, the Cognito user pool has 0 users (groups admin, curator, editor; Google IdP defined). Item, PublishedItem, MediaAsset, Edition, NewsroomSection, Reference are all 0: the CMS has never held content. Therefore convert-bodies has nothing to convert, and bootstrap.md sections 4 and 5 (sections, categories, corpus sync) were never run.
- Today's backend schema = Papyrus main d04b068 (job 17, data stack updated 2026-10-05T13:54Z). main has no bodyMarkus. Schema diff main to develop: Item and PublishedItem gain bodyMarkus, bodyIr, aliases, metadata (all optional); 5 new custom mutations (deriveMarkus, saveItemDraft, publishItem, unpublishItem, requestStagingBuild) served by a new Python Lambda; storage rule preview/* (editor/admin read); auth moves to defineSiteAuth; backend.ts moves to defineSiteBackend. The schema.ts diff adds NO secondary index. Additive for AppSync/DynamoDB; the failure mode of ampx pipeline-deploy is a failed job and CloudFormation rollback (jobs 12-15 failed that way and production kept serving).
- CMS app renders no Pretext article pages (brand renderer markus): the PRT (#109) bodyIr gate cannot be hit on this app. The brand equality gate (BRD) holds: live branch values equal pilobol-us (both vars).
- PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE live value is graphql, invalid on develop (published|drafts): the app would throw. SITE_ENV is unset (treated as development).
- Stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us holds the app with PAT-based repository (secret amplify/github-app-token; keep it until the retirement ticket: it is the rollback path).

## Exact steps
1. Preconditions: proof ticket and rehearsal ticket accepted; counts re-checked = 0 immediately before (Item, PublishedItem, MediaAsset scan COUNT); save get-app, get-branch, get-template (CloudFormation) to scratch.
2. Verify the stack changes made in the proof ticket are still in place (get-app: buildSpec generated, repository AnthusAI/Pilobol.us; get-branch main env names unchanged, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE equals published and SITE_ENV equals production by equality check, values not printed). If a stack update since then dropped the repository connection, reconnect in the console first.
3. Confirm app d11eu9hbs2mipk is connected to AnthusAI/Pilobol.us (done in the proof ticket); get-app platform WEB_COMPUTE and iamServiceRoleArn unchanged.
4. Pilobol.us: merge the scaffold PR to main (Ryan yes). This also triggers a reader build on app d1od6t7lzbwanr (spec from the reader-spec ticket): confirm it is byte-identical (parity harness). The scaffold changes nothing under web/.
5. Ryan yes (LIVE): aws amplify start-job --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name main --job-type RELEASE (CMS main autoBuild is still off). Watch the job (about 13 minutes). Then aws amplify update-branch ... --enable-auto-build.
6. Verify (read-only): job SUCCEED; data stack LastUpdatedTime moved; aws appsync get-type --api-id daczqhhg25b2nfgrzpyc4vd7eq --type-name PublishedItem --format SDL contains bodyMarkus; table count still 39 and all 0; https://newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom returns 200 and Ryan checks it in a browser (release-gate item 3: verified in a browser); robots.txt is production (Allow, no noindex, no banner); aws iam get-role-policy on the content-actions Lambda role shows amplify:StartJob only on apps/d1od6t7lzbwanr.
7. First admin: Ryan signs in (Google or email) and an admin group assignment is made (aws cognito-idp admin-add-user-to-group, Ryan yes) so the editor UI works; sign-in test with a non-editor account must see no Item data.

## Acceptance checks
- All verify items in step 6. Release-gate mapping: SCH deployed (step 6), convert-bodies not applicable (0 rows, evidence in step 1), browser check (step 6), BRD equality, PRV middleware proven on the proof branch and now on production.
- No production row, user or object was created by this ticket except the admin user of step 7.

## Rollback
- Build failure: nothing to roll back (job fails, previous deployment keeps serving; confirm get-branch activeJobId unchanged).
- Bad deployment: Amplify console "Redeploy this version" on job 17 (old frontend; additive schema stays, harmless).
- Full revert (backend is empty): reconnect the app to AnthusAI/Papyrus in the console, re-apply the saved previous stack template (saved in the proof ticket), keep autoBuild off until it is verified. The PAT secret must still exist. No data to restore.

## Risks
- Replacement of auth/data resources if the refactor changed construct ids: with an empty backend, a replaced user pool or table loses nothing, but a replaced Cognito domain (papyrus-pilobol-us) can clash and roll the job back; the Google OAuth redirect URI at Google depends on that prefix.
- The knowledgevectors (S3 Vectors) stack uses the old naming; brand-namespaced names in defineSiteBackend may create a second index: acceptable (empty).
- 12-13 minute CMS builds; secrets present for main already (names verified in SSM).

## Needs Ryan
Yes for steps 4, 5, 7; browser check (step 6). SSO login.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
right_now_summary: The production CMS migration awaits Ryan’s approval for the merge, release, browser check, and admin sign-in.
